'''Chris Perman''' was a Decipher-era [[Squadron Members|Squadron Member]], listed as Red 95 from Oakdale, MN, later St. Paul, MN.<ref name="sm-fan" /> The slot was retired after Decipher's SWCCG run.

A pharmacist developing products at 3M, he supported players in the Twin Cities.<ref name="decsq-prof" />
